g.text: By using the multiple regression analysis, the lecturer can identify which
teaching method (predictor variable) contributes the most to teaching
effectiveness (the criterion variable) among the tutors.
In this case, there re five predictor variables for one criterion variable;
thus, the calculation for regression can be done using the regression
Ŷ = b₁X₁ + b₂X₂ + b₃X₃ + b₄X₄ + b₅X₅ + a
